formal_statement: ¬∃ (x1 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), (63 : ℕ) ≤ x1.size ∧ x1.size ≤ (64 : ℕ) ∧ (∀ (x2 : ℕ) (x3 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate), x1.gates[x2]? = Option.some x3 → (x3.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∨ x3.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or) ∧ ∃ (x5 : ℕ) (x6 : ℕ), x3.inputs = [x5, x6] ∧ x5 ≠ x6 ∧ x5 < (26 : ℕ) + x2 ∧ x6 < (26 : ℕ) + x2) ∧ (∀ (x2 : Fin (26 : ℕ) → Bool), x1.eval (List.ofFn x2) = Bool.true ↔ ∃ (x3 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) (x4 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), (x3 = x4 ∨ x3 = x4 + (1 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) ∨ x3 = x4 + (3 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) ∨ x3 = x4 + (9 : Fin (13 : ℕ))) ∧ x2 (Fin.castAdd (13 : ℕ) x3) = Bool.true ∧ x2 (Fin.natAdd (13 : ℕ) x4) = Bool.true) ∧ (∃ (x2 : ℕ → Bool), (∀ x3 < (26 : ℕ), x2 x3 = Decidable.decide (x3 = (13 : ℕ))) ∧ (∀ (x3 : ℕ) (x4 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) (x5 x6 : ℕ), x1.gates[x3]? = Option.some x4 → x4.inputs = [x5, x6] → (x4.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and → x2 ((26 : ℕ) + x3) = ((x1.wires (List.ofFn fun (x10 : Fin (26 : ℕ)) => Decidable.decide (↑x10 = (0 : ℕ)))).getD x5 Bool.false && x2 x6 || x2 x5 && (x1.wires (List.ofFn fun (x10 : Fin (26 : ℕ)) => Decidable.decide (↑x10 = (0 : ℕ)))).getD x6 Bool.false)) ∧ (x4.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or → x2 ((26 : ℕ) + x3) = (x2 x5 || x2 x6))) ∧ x2 x1.output = Bool.false) ∧ ∃ (x2 : ℕ → Bool), (∀ x3 < (26 : ℕ), x2 x3 = Decidable.decide (x3 = (0 : ℕ))) ∧ (∀ (x3 : ℕ) (x4 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) (x5 x6 : ℕ), x1.gates[x3]? = Option.some x4 → x4.inputs = [x5, x6] → (x4.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and → x2 ((26 : ℕ) + x3) = ((x1.wires (List.ofFn fun (x10 : Fin (26 : ℕ)) => Decidable.decide (↑x10 = (13 : ℕ)))).getD x5 Bool.false && x2 x6 || x2 x5 && (x1.wires (List.ofFn fun (x10 : Fin (26 : ℕ)) => Decidable.decide (↑x10 = (13 : ℕ)))).getD x6 Bool.false)) ∧ (x4.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or → x2 ((26 : ℕ) + x3) = (x2 x5 || x2 x6))) ∧ x2 x1.output = Bool.false
plain_statement: Plane of order 3, points as inputs 0 to 12 and lines as inputs 13 to 25. No circuit of 63 or 64 AND and OR gates, each reading two different earlier wires, computes the incidence function and has (point 0, line 0) as a double re-read incidence (reached neither reading the line once nor reading the point once).
title: A step toward: Order 3 plane: no circuit of at most 64 AND/OR gates of fan-in two (distinct earlier wires) computes incidence and has a double re-read incidence
